earnings.title: INVESTOR RELATIONS:
highlights: BlackRock Reports Third Quarter 2026 Diluted EPS of $10.57, or $15.93 as adjusted

19% increase in year-over-year GAAP operating income and 25% increase in GAAP diluted EPS impacted by a noncash change in fair value of contingent consideration associated with prior acquisitions, which has been excluded from as adjusted results
27% increase in year-over-year as adjusted operating income
38% increase in year-over-year as adjusted diluted EPS also reflects higher nonoperating income in the current quarter
19% increase in revenue year-over-year reflects the positive impact of markets, organic base fee growth, higher performance fees, and higher technology services and subscription revenue

items.heading: Changes in the value levels of equity, debt, real assets, commodities, foreign exchange or other asset markets, including from the impact of global trade policies and tariffs, may cause assets under management (“AUM”), revenue and earnings to decline.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO MARKET AND COMPETITION

items.heading: Changes in interest or foreign exchange rates and/or global markets may impact BlackRock’s AUM, base fees as well as net income and operating cash flows.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO MARKET AND COMPETITION

items.heading: BlackRock’s investment advisory contracts may be terminated or may not be renewed by clients and fund boards on favorable terms and the liquidation of certain funds may be accelerated at the option of investors.

items.heading: The failure or negative performance of products offered by competitors may cause AUM in similar BlackRock products to decline irrespective of BlackRock’s performance.

items.heading: Increased competition may cause BlackRock’s AUM, revenue and earnings to decline.
